metaDescription: Order custom Debco badge ID holders for your team. Durable, reliable, and ready for bulk orders at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Debco badge ID holders offer a trusted combination of durability and clarity for daily use in offices, hospitals, and trade shows. Whether you need vinyl pouches with hang holes for easy scanning or nylon neck wallets for secure card storage, these holders resist wear and keep IDs visible. Choose clear or colored styles and add your logo through screen printing or embroidery on attached lanyards. Perfect for bulk orders where consistent quality matters.
